notes: Hand-picked for a trip to the Azores (São Miguel, Terceira, Graciosa and the whale-watching boat trips). The Iberia trip holds the mainland birds; this pack adds the two Azores endemics (Azores Bullfinch of São Miguel's laurel forest and Azores Chaffinch), the Atlantic Canary, and the seabirds: Monteiro's and Band-rumped Storm-Petrels, Bulwer's Petrel, Cory's and Barolo Shearwaters, and the Roseate Tern colonies. Common Buzzard, Common Tern, Yellow-legged Gull, Grey Wagtail, Blackcap and Common Moorhen, which also live on the islands, are in the Iberia trip. The autumn American vagrants that the Azores are known for are in two units: the strays that come most years (Ring-billed Gull, American Black Duck, American Wigeon, Blue-winged Teal, Lesser Yellowlegs, Pectoral and Semipalmated Sandpiper, Killdeer, American Golden Plover). One-off rarities are left out.
